usageNotes: Use this endpoint to initiate a controlled reboot or shutdown of a PDM-managed node. The caller must hold the Sys.PowerManagement privilege on the /system/status ACL path; API tokens are supported. The API returns null immediately — there is no UPID, so the operation is fire-and-forget; monitor node availability separately to confirm the power action completed.
tips: Use 'localhost' as the node name to target the PDM host itself when the API is served from that node.
Because the return is null, do not poll for a task UPID — instead, watch for the node to go offline and reconnect.
Prefer 'reboot' over 'shutdown' in automated workflows unless you have a confirmed bring-up path (IPMI, WoL) to recover a shut-down node.
